integrity: Proof is constructive and finite checker bundled; public text states exact hypotheses and known inputs without inventing independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Standard filiform Lie algebras only, all finite fields q and dimensions n>=4. No general filiform deformation or endomorphism-conjugacy classification. Finite exhaustive tests are checks, not an infinite proof. No independent external assessment; priority may be affected by unindexed equivalents.
title: Complete endomorphism-rank census and a two-scale limit law for standard filiform Lie algebras
